svg.text: sixty lines, one lunar day of 24 h 50 min each, read downward

text.tspan: Left, the record as it came: 1,464 hours pressed into 300 pixels,
five hours to a column, every tide crushed into its own smear.
Above, the 798 dots that could still be told apart, each set back on
the clock of the moon. Dark is high, pale is low; red goes higher than any tide.
